observations.text: Mechanical selection of the delta since the stale approval's revision. argv 'git diff --stat 7a641c9..371398e -- crates/foundry-acceptance', exit 0, stdout exactly the three declared oracle/support files - tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature +120/-10 overall file total, src/support/instance_integration_setup.rs +321, src/steps/feature_instance_integration_setup.rs +69 - empty stderr; the fourth declared support, src/support/external_integration_plugins.rs, is absent from the delta and therefore unchanged. argv 'git diff --stat 7a641c9..371398e' (whole tree), exit 0: one further test file changed by this Request's turns, crates/foundry-store/tests/iis_instance_store.rs +292, which is where S2's store row is run; the rest is production source, templates, the migration, xtask and the feature's own documents. argv 'git status --porcelain', exit 0, one line '?? docs/feature/iis-slack-replace-remove/.nwdes-drafts/' - no tracked oracle, support or test byte is uncommitted, so the judged bytes are the committed ones at 371398e. Re-review is limited to this delta; every judgment of the 78736ff and 7a641c9 reviews that it does not touch stands, including the copy-fidelity and step-definition evidence and the recorded semantic RED.

S2's own oracle bytes are unchanged; the later slice only appended. argv 'git diff 7a641c9..371398e -- crates/foundry-acceptance/tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature', exit 0, two hunks: the file's own header comment, where 'The rest of US-IIS-05 (the I-14 confirm while workspaces are connected, Remove, the environment-app rules) ... are not here yet' becomes 'the I-14 confirm while workspaces are connected, and Remove with the environment-app rules (I-15, I-16, the I-18 "removed" line). US-IIS-07 (Start over) is not here yet'; and 115 added lines after line 934, nine @us-iis-05 remove scenarios with their own section comment. Not one line of the eleven S2 scenarios (feature lines 800-946) is added, removed or changed, and the rotation guard at line 801 that discharged the previous blocking finding is byte-identical. The locked I-14 line, the n = 1 wording, the 'Save the new app' control, 'the page shows no key and no Slack secret' and the Activity tables all read exactly as approved at 7a641c9.

No shared support step was weakened; the delta is additive with three touches on shared items, each judged. argv 'git diff 7a641c9..371398e -- crates/foundry-acceptance/src/support/instance_integration_setup.rs crates/foundry-acceptance/src/steps/feature_instance_integration_setup.rs', exit 0. (1) InstanceDoor gains SlackRemove: the SlackConfirm arm's door constant and its empty fields() are untouched, so 'posts a Slack confirm request', '... anyway' and '... again' post exactly what they posted. (2) Button gains RemoveApp and the step regex gains the "Remove" alternative: Button::parse("Save the new app") and SaveNewApp's copy() are unchanged. (3) Signer::parse adds the alternative text 'the signing secret the removed app was saved with' to the existing Saved arm; the arm's secret is unchanged, and the added text names the same secret, so no S1 or S2 positive verification is relaxed. One regex was widened - then_slack_not_set_up moved from '^Slack is still not set up' to '^Slack is (?:still not|no longer) set up' - while its body (support:1683-1698, two assertions: the page does not read 'Slack: set up here', and Canzan Labs is not offered Add to Slack) is not in the delta and is unchanged; no S2 scenario uses that step. Every function an S2 scenario reaches - then_nothing_waiting and its single WAITING constant, then_saved_app_unchanged, then_on_confirm_page, when_choose_on_confirm, then_answers_integrations_page, instance_page, then_approval_for - is absent from the delta. The whole-feature lane ran 105 scenarios with 0 parsing and 0 hook errors, so the nine added step definitions introduce no ambiguous match against an S2 step.

The one open non-blocking finding of the 7a641c9 approval is discharged, exactly as its remediation asked. In acceptance.md the S2 row 'crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/instance.rs :: the table of what the confirm and remove pages reach when they are only read' now reads stimulus 'The confirm page is opened, with a submission waiting and with none.' (was '... and the remove page is opened with an app saved.'), expected 'Each of those openings only reads: the stored rows, the recorded activity and this Foundry configuration version are exactly what they were, so no replica is told to reload anything.', and user result 'A browser or a link preview that opens the confirm page for Priya decides nothing and disturbs no server.' The row's obligations stay L6/F201 and L6/F202, both confirm-door cases, and the remove-door case F203 is now cited by the remove slice's own row rather than by S2's. The locator keeps its name, which the remediation allowed for a table meant to grow, and the table did grow: at HEAD it reads both ReadOnlyDoor::SlackConfirm and ReadOnlyDoor::SlackRemove. No S2 row now states an observation this slice cannot construct.

The L3 amendment neither changes nor strands any S2-cited case. argv 'git diff 7a641c9..371398e -- docs/feature/iis-slack-replace-remove/architecture.md', exit 0: L3's statement F660 gains a third fact ('... and an app is in effect - the environment's or the saved one; a NewApp with no connected workspace, a NewApp while no app is in effect, and every Rotate are saved at once'), one case F661 is added ('NewApp with 1 connected workspace left behind by a removed app, no app in effect: saved at once, no pending row, and no confirm page naming an empty client ID'), and the finite reason F662 now reads three closed facts. The texts of S2's five cited L3 cases F180, F181, F182, F183 and F184 are untouched, and no L4, L6 or L11 case or statement changed at all. The new clause's case F661 is bound in the handoff to the later slice's public scenario 'After the removal Canzan Labs reads that Slack is not set up, and loses nothing it had' / 'Setting the same app up again finds Canzan Labs still connected' (covers P5), not left for S2: the state it names, no app in effect with connections left behind, is only reachable through a removal this slice does not deliver. D16, D17 and D18 are new decision records governing S1-S3, S2 and S1-S2; none contradicts an S2 row (see the separate observation).

Both completion obligations retained at the 7a641c9 approval are now discharged in the bytes, and the amended three-fact gate is tabled. (1) crates/foundry-store/tests/iis_instance_store.rs:868 the_finite_table_of_when_a_held_slack_app_may_still_be_applied reads the fencepost L4/F188 named: the hold expires at at(10), and the table is [(holder, +1, applies), (holder, +9, applies), (holder, +10, NOT applied), (holder, +11, NOT applied), (other admin, +1, NOT applied)], each refused case asserting the whole dump is byte-identical before and after; it also reads the second confirm finding no row, and the prune boundary (0 deleted at at(9), 1 at at(10)). The fixed instant at(minutes) is far from the wall clock, so a store reading now() is caught, and the applied case asserts the stored sealed bytes are the held bytes passed through the caller's re-seal closure, which is D17's contract. (2) crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/instance.rs:1784 the_count_forms_i14_and_i15_read_and_the_gate_the_connected_count_decides now reads the gate over counts 0, 1, 2, 3 and 137 for each of AppInEffect::Saved and AppInEffect::Environment, and over AppInEffect::None for every count, plus the I-14 lines for n = 1, 2, 3 and the I-15 lines for n = 0, 1, 2, 3 against the locked copy. (3) instance.rs:1934 the_table_of_what_the_confirm_and_remove_pages_reach_when_they_are_only_read asserts each read-only door's reads are PageRead variants only. All three pass in the root's run at the amendment: argv 'scripts/test-in-lima.sh cargo xtask smoke', log ~/.cache/nwdes/iis-slack-replace-remove/amend-smoke.txt, final line 'xtask smoke :: all gates green', with 'test integrations::handlers::instance::tests::the_count_forms_i14_and_i15_read_and_the_gate_the_connected_count_decides ... ok' at log line 61 and 'test the_finite_table_of_when_a_held_slack_app_may_still_be_applied ... ok' at log line 1077 under 'Running tests/iis_instance_store.rs'. This reviewer executed no new run for these; it cites that log and the crafter's recorded 'cargo test -p foundry-store --test iis_instance_store' and 'cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations', both exit 0.

No crate, test, script, migration, template or manifest byte differs between the green run and HEAD, and the acceptance lane reads none of the changed files, so the run's inputs are established equivalent. The earlier semantic RED stands as recorded at 7a641c9 (nine confirm scenarios failing on public answers, zero parsing and zero hook errors, log ~/.cache/nwdes/iis-slack-replace-remove/s2-red-2.txt); it is retained as evidence, not re-executed.

The three new decision records leave every S2 row observable, and the later slice's page rules do not close S2's journey. D16 (post, redirect, get, with the notice a one-shot session value and never a query value): no S2 scenario or step keys on a query notice - argv 'grep -rn "saved=" crates/foundry-acceptance/src', exit 0, zero lines - and S2's rows read 'Priya reads "Saved. ..."' with 'Priya is on the instance integrations page', which the redirect-then-read journey satisfies; the previous RED log's '?saved=app-environment' answer was the pre-implementation behaviour, not an oracle expectation.
